raise_Abandoned: raise the Abandoned exception to signal intentional abandonment of a computation
catch_Abandoned: catch the Abandoned exception in a try-except block to handle abandoned computations
subclass_Abandoned: subclass the Abandoned exception to add custom metadata about why computation was abandoned
check_Abandoned_isinstance: check if an exception is an instance of Abandoned using isinstance
import_Abandoned: import the Abandoned exception class from the abandonment module for use in error handling
